content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The phone layout is warm, well-paced and immediately shows the farm, what it offers and how to get in touch.",
  "desktopNote": "On the desktop first screen the hero photo is so tall that it pushes the intro copy and action links off the bottom of the viewport, and in the accommodation section the photo-less apartment card stretches to match the photo card beside it, leaving a huge empty box.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 5,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 2,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the desktop hero image height or move the overlapping dark text card higher so the full intro paragraph and primary links fit inside the first 800px screen.",
    "In the desktop 'Nastanitev' section, either align the 'Apartma za 4 osebe' card to the top (align-items: start) or redesign the two-unit layout so the photo-less card does not have a giant empty area beneath its text.",
    "Style the primary hero action ('Pišite nam' or 'Pokličite') as a solid button rather than two equally weighted underlined text links."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On the desktop first screen, the hero text box is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, slicing through the first line of body copy and hiding the call-to-action links.",
    "On desktop in the 'Nastanitev' section, the right-hand card ('Apartma za 4 osebe') stretches to the height of the image card next to it, creating a broken-looking empty box."
  ]
}
